statement: Cascade and footprint views observe the production deferred shadow selector and projection, including the production UV and texel footprint. Registered GL-free source/catalogue and hidden-GL regressions cover these views; native execution remains pending. Diagnostic shadow footprints use the existing unsupported RGB sentinel (-2,-2,-2) whenever any derivative-quad lane has a missing, cleared or nonfinite position, including diagonal neighbours; cascade selection remains independently observable. Registered DiagnosticContributionsGl regressions cover all 16 quad-validity masks for Legacy and Ladder position backends, nonfinite storage and cleared depth, with a finite fully valid control; native execution remains pending.
